headline: Godcrofts Leads Renewed Base Fighting
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the lull breaking unevenly, with Godcrofts now the busiest strategic front: 42 base events in 24 hours and 12 in the latest two-hour window, while its nine bases remain divided six Warden to three Colonial. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle each record 31 events; Stlican retains the same six-to-three division, while Stonecradle now stands five Warden to four Colonial amid heavy but cooling casualties. Weathered Expanse has eased to 36 events, with six Warden and three Colonial bases, though enlistments are accelerating. Fisherman’s Row has climbed to 29 events, including two in the latest two hours; eight bases are Colonial-held and one is presently neutral. Callahan’s Passage, by contrast, has cooled to seven daily events and no movement in the latest two-hour window, despite intense recent casualty totals and complete Warden control. The most immediate ownership-change watch therefore lies with the divided fronts and Fisherman’s Row, where recent base turnover remains evident.
